title: Sarcin-ricin motif
subtitle: A formal seven-nucleotide interaction graph projected into RNAdex, then validated from atomic coordinates with official FR3D interaction and geometric criteria.
definition: The formal core has two strands, X1-X4 and Y1-Y3, with five backbone links, four specified non-Watson-Crick base pairs, and four specified stacking interactions.
query: RNAdex Stage 1 retains the five backbone links and four generic non-WC edges. A composition filter then requires the published core sequence space (A/G)GUA/(A/G)AA.
boundary_note: RNAdex topology and sequence filters generate candidates, not motif assignments. The displayed representatives and fixed-seed audit sample were reannotated from atomic coordinates with FR3D and required to pass every interaction check and the literature-derived discrepancy cutoff. Only the displayed representatives are presented as high-confidence canonical examples; the broader candidate counts must not be interpreted as confirmed motif counts.

stage_counts.label: Candidates in the formal core sequence space

workflow_steps.label: Define
workflow_steps.text: Use the published seven-node graph rather than a motif name or a short sequence alone.

workflow_steps.label: Retrieve
workflow_steps.text: Search RNAdex internal loops for the projected backbone and generic non-WC topology.

workflow_steps.label: Filter
workflow_steps.text: Retain candidates compatible with the published (A/G)GUA/(A/G)AA core sequence space.

workflow_steps.label: Validate
workflow_steps.text: Atomic coordinates were reannotated with official FR3D Python. The complete St-Onge seven-nucleotide interaction signature and the published FR3D five-nucleotide geometric cutoff were both required.

acceptance_criteria: RNAdex internal loop bounded by two canonical WC pairs.
All four formal Leontis-Westhof base pairs detected by FR3D.
All four formal stacking interactions detected by FR3D.
Five-nucleotide FR3D discrepancy to 1JJ2 is at most 0.5.
